50 | True Eye | caster | 1 md/lvl | self | F

# Descriptions
@@ 1
The caster senses the presence of any Holy or Unholy objects, consecrated
ground, or other works of Channeling in the area. Caster may concentrate on a
different area each round.
@@ 2
Detects the total number of “enemies” in the area of effect (giving
approximate direction and distance). This spell also reveals the most heavily
represented type of enemy (by total levels). Caster can concentrate on a
different area each round. Will also reveal if caster’s “Mark” is among the
enemies.
@@ 3
Caster places a mental mark on one target within range, enabling him to use
some of the spells on the “Vengeance” spell list against him, as well as
spells on this list. The caster can only have one “Mark” per three levels
(round up).
@@ 4
Detects any active spell or item from any realm; caster can concentrate on a
different 5’R each round. Caster will learn the realm of magic and the type of
any spells in the area.
@@ 5
Caster has a 75% chance of detecting a trap in the area of effect (trap
sophistication may modify this chance). The caster can concentrate on a
different area each round.
@@ 6
All of the caster’s Tracking maneuvers receive a bonus of +50.
@@ 7
Detects all invisible objects or beings in the area of effect. Caster can
concentrate on a different 10’R each round. All attacks against something so
detected are modified by -50. See Spell Luw Section 15.5 for rules on
invisibility.
@@ 8
Caster can check one object or place (up to a 10-foot-radius) and tell if it
is an illusion or has an illusion on it.
@@ 9
As Detect Magic, except it will also give an estimate of the power (i.e. the
level) of the person, item, or spell examined.
@@ 10
As Detect Enemies I, except for range and area of effect.
@@ 11
Detects any poisons on a single object or a single being.
@@ 12
As Detect Holy/Unholy, except for range and duration.
@@ 13
Caster learns the direction and distance to any one of the caster’s “Marks”.
@@ 14
Attempts to learn from the target’s mind what Divine Status level he has. See
Section 6.0 for more information on Divine Status.
@@ 15
Caster can remember an exact route he traveled, whether or not he was without
one or more of his senses when he made his original journey (e.g. a 12th level
caster could remember the course of 12 hours of a trip even if he had been
blindfolded). To be effective, this spell must be cast within one month of the
journey.
@@ 16
Caster receives a divine vision of one of the caster’s “Marks” specified at
the time of casting. The vision will only reveal general activities of the
target (i.e., target is fighting, target is sleeping, target is gambling,
etc.). The caster’s “Mark” must be within range of this spell, location of the
“Mark” will not be revealed.
@@ 17
As Tracking, except the bonus is +75.
@@ 18
As Perceive Power, except for range and area of effect.
@@ 19
Gives the direction and distance to any specific object or place that the
caster is familiar with or has had described in detail. The caster must have
the dimensions of the object exact within 10% of actual size and know at least
two other attributes that make the item unique (e.g., color, texture, weight,
etc.). Note that sometimes the caster must know more than two other attributes
to make the item unique.
@@ 20
As Detect Enemies I, except for range and area of effect.
@@ 25
Caster sees through any illusions, facades, invisibility, or other
misrepresentations of the truth.
@@ 30
As The Eye, except the caster does not need to know exactly where the target
is located.
@@ 50
Caster can use any one of the lower level spells on this list once per round.
